clause: DESIGN R3.3 §2.4.1 CR-06 write set; action/write matrix (ensure)
author: spec-seal
derivation: Every ensure demands {envelope,/bindings,binding} (DESIGN §2.4.1 action/write matrix: parent/property create AND envelope /bindings binding). The variant drops that declared write from ensure-supports, so the declared and required write sets differ and compilation refuses profile-write-set.
